scope_guards: An enquiry is not treated as an approved investment.
A pipeline entry is not treated as a funding commitment.
An investment decision may change before signed agreements and is not treated as final funding.
A signed funding agreement is not treated as completed infrastructure.
Land acquisition support is not treated as acquired title.
Remediation funding is not treated as certified remediation.
A housing target is not treated as completed homes.
No score or promotion is written without signed funding, land, works, completions and monitored outcome evidence.
